notes: Head of s005 on *cruse* rather than *alabaster*: the ASV's own margin glosses ἀλάβαστρον *a flask*, so the vessel noun glosses the lexeme under rule 66 and is not a generic completion of the πραιτώριον → *praetorian guard* kind.
μύρου is discontinuous (*of … ointment*) with βαρυτίμου's *exceeding precious* intervening; rule 27 keeps them apart.
